contribution_origins.grain: Source state code and date inclusion category for selected distinct principal committee IDs and archive cycle.

fields.state: Exact reported contributor state code; no normalization.
fields.date_scope: Included, Invalid or missing date, or Outside date range.
fields.records: Count of raw reported transaction records; not unique donors.
fields.recorded_amount: Sum of parseable signed decimal amounts; not official fundraising.
fields.invalid_amount_records: Records with missing/invalid amounts; included in counts, not amounts.
fields.memo_records: Records whose memo_cd is X; retained.
fields.amendment_records: Records whose amndt_ind is A; retained.

contribution_origins.recipient_selection: Distinct principal committee IDs from House/Senate candidate records matching the selected race state and archive; default Maryland, 50 states plus DC supported. Optional election year/candidate filters apply.
contribution_origins.map_exclusion: Selected campaign state excluded from color scale and map shares by default; totals and exports retain it. Toggle restores it.
